name: Shoot more
desc: Shoots more often, including from outside the box.

name: Shoot less
desc: Looks for the pass instead of the shot.
tip: Players who waste possession by shooting.

name: Dribble more
desc: Carries the ball and looks for the one-on-one.

name: Dribble less
desc: Releases the ball earlier.

name: Take more risks
desc: Tries defence-splitting passes.

name: Take fewer risks
desc: Safe passes.

name: Cross from byline
desc: Goes to the byline before crossing.

name: Cross from deep
desc: Crosses earlier, from deeper.
tip: Wing-backs and inside wingers with good Crossing.

name: Roam from position
desc: Freedom to leave his position.
tip: Only for players with high Decisions/Off the Ball; adds complexity.

name: Stay wider
desc: Stays wider.

name: Sit narrower
desc: Tucks inside.

name: Hold position
desc: Stays in his zone instead of following the attack.

name: Get further forward
desc: Gets into the final third more often.
tip: Midfielders/full-backs with high Stamina and Off the Ball.

name: Move into channels
desc: Looks for the space between centre-back and full-back.

name: Press more
desc: Presses more than the rest of the team.

name: Press less
desc: Saves energy when pressing.

name: Mark tighter
desc: Tighter marking.

name: Tackle harder
desc: Harder tackles.

name: Ease off tackles
desc: More careful tackles.
tip: Weak tackling or a booked player.

name: Arrive Late
desc: Arrives in the box as a second wave, attacking the space that opens up.

name: Attack the Defensive Line
desc: Attacks depth on the last line.
tip: Quick Poachers, Channel Forwards, Inside Forwards.

name: Target Near Post
desc: Attacks the near post on crosses.

name: Target Centre
desc: Attacks the centre of the box on crosses.

name: Target Far Post
desc: Attacks the far post on crosses.
